title: Mochizuki Honami — The Courage I've Mustered〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Seriously, where am I...?)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
(My phone's gone...
Maybe I dropped it somewhere close by...?)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Hmm... These glowing plants are very pretty, but kind of scary at the same time... I should probably avoid touching them...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Hm? What's this? A piece of paper...?
No, it feels like leather...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, there's a small star mark in the center.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Could this be some kind of map?
Does this star represent the exit?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But there aren't any paths or landmarks... I don't even know where I am right now...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (And I'll just get lost if I start walking around without a plan...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I even remember hearing how it's better to just stay put when you lose your way on a mountain.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Ichika and the others may come and find me if I wait here...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Tomorrow, once they realize that I'm not at school, they should figure out that...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
No... That's not the solution...
Mom, Ichika, everyone... They're going to be so worried...

rows.Speaker: Honami's Classmate
rows.Line:
But I'm really glad...
You seem to really understand how I feel, Mochizuki.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I promised to talk to her tomorrow.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I have to find a way back.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I should put something on the ground to remind myself that this is my starting point.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: In terms of paths... I should see if some animals made any... I don't have much to go on right now, but that should lower my chances of getting lost...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Alright...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, I'm seeing signs of animals having passed this way... I can start by following this little trail...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I can't even see where I started now...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (And the star on this map-like drawing is still puzzling me... Hm?)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Wait, a line's been drawn in the lower lefthand corner. This wasn't here before...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Oh, is there where I've walked...?
If so, I should be able to find my way toward the star!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (There's no guarantee that the star is where the exit is, but I feel much more hopeful now.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Phew... My surroundings still look more or less the same, but I'm making progress toward where the star is...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Just a little more to go...

rows.Speaker: Someone's Voice
rows.Line: Ho...mi...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: A voice? Is someone calling for me...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Could it be Ichika and the others...?!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I've moved away from the star a little bit... But that person's voice was definitely coming from somewhere around here...)

rows.Speaker: Someone's Voice
rows.Line: “Seriously, Honami's such a bootlicker.”

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Someone's Voice
rows.Line: “She always just smiles and nods while listening to someone's problems.”

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Wh-What are these voices...?
Where are they coming from...?

rows.Speaker: Someone's Voice
rows.Line: “She makes people feel like they owe her so much while feeling all high and mighty. What a phony.”

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: N-No, that wasn't what I was...

rows.Speaker: Someone's Voice
rows.Line: “Then, what are you gonna tell that girl tomorrow? How you think her dream's so wonderful? How you're gonna help her out so much?”

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: W-Wait...

rows.Speaker: Someone's Voice
rows.Line:
“You can't do anything.”
“And yet, you're this nosey.”

rows.Speaker: Someone's Voice
rows.Line: “Can't you see that nobody wants your phony kindness?”

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Classmate
rows.Line: Whose side are you on?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: *Sob*

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I... I just...
Hey! Where are you...?!
Honami!
Honami! Say something if you can hear us!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
That voice... Len?
MEIKO and Miku too...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Is it really them...?
Did they come looking for me...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Calm down...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I'm not the old me anymore.)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: But it sounds like you already know what you want to do, Honami. You genuinely want to be there for Shiho, right?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I can at least say that I don't think resolve and commitment aren't things you can learn about from others.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: What do you think it means to be kind, Honami?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I don't care if nobody wants my kindness...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I appreciate the fact that others are willing to open up to me about their problems, but that's not why I'm kind to them.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'm kind to them because I just can't leave them be...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I know that I can't always actually help them, but I can at least encourage them by letting them know that I'm there for support!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: That's why I'm going to show my kindness to my classmate once more by talking with her tomorrow!
School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hm...? W-Wait... I'm back on the rooftop...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Honami...!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Wah! M-Miku?!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Are you okay? You're not hurt, are you?!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Relax, Miku...
As far as I can tell, she's perfectly fine.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: He's right. Also, I'm sure Honami's still confused regarding what just happened.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: So, that “fragment of a feeling” sent me to a different SEKAI...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes. However, I was surprised to hear that you were sent into a jungle. I wonder whose feelings those were.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: On top of it all, you vanished and left only your phone behind.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But even if you had it with you, fragments act as the entrances to their respective SEKAI, so you wouldn't have been able to use Untitled to get back.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Anyway, here's your phone.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Thank you, Miku.
You too, MEIKO, Len...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (If they hadn't come looking for me, I probably would've stayed stuck in that place...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Thank you for coming to find me...
Thank you all so very much...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: It was no big deal.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Exactly. We're just glad to see that you're safe.
The next day
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Class 1-B

rows.Speaker: Honami's Classmate
rows.Line: Good morning, Mochizuki...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, good morning.

rows.Speaker: Honami's Classmate
rows.Line:
I need to apologize about yesterday.
You probably weren't expecting me to dump the story of my life on you like that...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: No, I'm really glad that you did.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: And I thought about it quite a lot...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: First, I think you need to take a hard look at what you're feeling.

rows.Speaker: Honami's Classmate
rows.Line: What I'm feeling...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: It's something one of my bandmates said a little while back.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We're trying to go pro, so we can't be happy with just being in a band together.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We have to be prepared to fully commit ourselves to our music.

rows.Speaker: Honami's Classmate
rows.Line: Commit...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: That's why I'd like you to ask yourself again to see if you truly want to become a marine biologist.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: And, even if it means butting heads with your mom, whether you will be able to pursue your dream without relenting or having any regrets.

rows.Speaker: Honami's Classmate
rows.Line:
Right...
Because it isn't easy to make your dream a reality.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Take me for instance. I'm reminded of just how far I still need to go each time our band plays a show.

rows.Speaker: Honami's Classmate
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Honami's Classmate
rows.Line:
Thank you, Mochizuki.
I'll take a step back and think about what I actually want to do.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Okay.

rows.Speaker: Honami's Classmate
rows.Line: Um... If it's alright with you, I'd like it if we could talk more again sometime...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Of course. I promise to support you until you find the answer.

rows.Speaker: Honami's Classmate
rows.Line: R-Really?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes. I mean, that's what classmates and friends are for, right?

rows.Speaker: Honami's Classmate
rows.Line:
Mochizuki...
Thank you so much...!
